questions: How many junctions did you fabricate and measure, and how many showed the zero-field diode, the hysteretic Fraunhofer pattern, the 170 μV feature and the asymmetric half-integer steps? The abstract says "Our devices", and the figures appear to come from one junction.
Why were the others set aside?
Which ranges of field (sweep amplitude and direction), temperature, microwave frequency and power did you measure beyond the ones shown, and over how many cooldowns?
What does the second-best junction or dataset look like?

What is the remanent field of the vector magnet at the sample after the sweeps you used, and does the symmetry point B0 = −8 G of η(Bx) (Fig. 2c, Supplementary Fig. 1b) stay where it is after warming above Tc,FTS and cooling at a compensated zero field? At Bx = 0 the junction sits 8 G from B0, so this tells a reader how much of the zero-field η = 9.8% comes from an offset field.
Which contacts carry the bias current into the top and bottom flakes, and does the diode polarity change when you feed the current through another contact pair?

Which field history preceded the Bx = 75 G Shapiro data, and do the half-integer steps and their ±1/2 asymmetry survive a thermal cycle above Tc,FTS or an approach to 75 G from the opposite field direction?
Near 75 G, does the ±1/2 asymmetry change with field on the roughly 11 G period of the fast Fraunhofer component?
